The dataset card (https://huggingface.co/datasets/common-pile/stackv2_edu_filtered) states:
" # Stack V2 Edu ## Description We filter the [Stack V2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-v2) to only include code from openly licensed repositories, based on the license detection performed by the creators of Stack V2."
"When multiple licenses are detected in a single repository, we ensure that all of the licenses are on the [Blue Oak Council certified license list](https://blueoakcouncil.org/list)."
"Per-document license information is available in the `license` entry of the `metadata` field of each example."
